label: dam-probes-p25-p26
_why: ENGINE PROBE (user, 2026-09-28: the chain rule is a safeguard against the AI dumping money into a half-built dam it never completes because it loses its standing; "the release mechanism could answer this satisfactorily enough that we will remove all restrictions"). p17b (session 20260928_162959) showed that releasing the subject CANCELS the overlord's construction in its state (Kaema Plateau 1841, Agno Gorge 1855) - but both releases came within a month of queuing, so no progress was at stake. p25 = p17b with dams.probe.release_delay_days 365: the first month a dam in a subject's state is seen under construction ARMS it and starts a one-year timer; the subject is released only when the timer has expired with the construction still standing. Arm: config/mod_config.probe-dam-p25.json = probe-dam-p17 + that key (contest seeding, class technologies at the top overlords, construction cost x0.25, electricity sinks, release from 1837).

_questions.Q1: When a subject is released a year into an overlord's dam construction, is the construction cancelled, kept, or completed - and how many construction points had been spent (the queue element's points left in the half-yearly save summaries before and after)?
_questions.Q2: If kept or completed: who owns the level (the former overlord's government, a financial district, the newly independent host)?

_predictions.Q1: cancelled, as in p17b, with the spent points lost

_caveats: Launch ONLY through tools/testbed/launch_detached.ps1 CALLED DIRECTLY from the PowerShell tool (landmine L30).
Probe build: technologies granted, costs shrunk - no economic reading.
_p26: THE DIRECT TEST of losing investment rights mid-build (user, 2026-09-28). config/mod_config.probe-dam-p26.json = probe-dam-p18 (no chain clause, the ten majors holding every survey; p18 saw Prussia build in Portugal and Sweden) + release_after 1837.1.1, release_delay_days 365, withdraw_rights: a dam under construction for a year in an INDEPENDENT host outside the ten majors makes the host WITHDRAW (vanilla effect withdraw = { country }) from every treaty carrying foreign_investment_rights. Q: is the foreign builder construction then cancelled, kept or completed, and with what spent? Caveat: Sweden is one of the ten majors, so a Trollhattan-like case does not qualify; p18 had ONE qualifying build (Portugal), so a null result is possible.
